name: PublishStagedImportRun
request_type: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1<PublishStagedImportRunInternalV1> containing complete parser result + exact run/profile/checkpoint inputs defined by ticket_import.source_check job contract plus the exact DurableJobClaimV1 held by the handler
response_type: bounded ImportRunPublicationResultV1 containing exact import_run_id, run_state, revision and proposal_count only; proposal identities are retrieved through the paginated ListReconciliationProposals query and are never embedded as an unbounded command result collection
transaction_boundary: bounded staging batches may commit while run remains unpublished validating; final publication/replay classification is one short UoW
authoritative_reads: current exact durable-job claim and exact current persisted source-check checkpoint through LLD-01 DurableJobCoordinator.assert_claim_current in the publication UnitOfWork; claim.checkpoint_json is not current authority
complete unpublished observations/fields/findings and recomputed counts/fingerprint

publication counters are recomputed from current child rows in the publication UoW: observed_row_count = COUNT(source_observations for run); valid_identity_count = COUNT(source_observations for run with identity_state='valid'); invalid_row_count = COUNT(source_observations for run with identity_state='invalid'); warning_count = COUNT(import_findings for run with severity='warning') only; proposal_count = COUNT(reconciliation_proposals for run); pending/accepted/rejected/deferred proposal counts each equal COUNT(reconciliation_proposals for run with the exact matching proposal_state)
guards: the exact ticket_import.source_check DurableJobClaimV1 is still current and running inside this same publication UnitOfWork immediately before receipt insertion; a prior checkpoint/read is not sufficient authority

the exact current checkpoint JSON returned by assert_claim_current is non-null, validates as TicketImportSourceCheckCheckpointV1, has phase=publishing, and binds this exact import_run_id, expected current run_revision, parser_profile_id and candidate_identity; claim.checkpoint_json is never substituted for this same-UoW witness

the current claim payload independently binds the same source_family, invocation_kind and profile_ids as the run/request, so a valid claim for another source locator/profile cannot publish this run even if an unrelated validating run exists

candidate remains exact stable source opened by job and equals the current publishing checkpoint candidate_identity; locator_fingerprint remains technical source identity evidence and is never reconstructed from display filename
profile/header/vocabulary/parser versions equal run provenance and current claim payload
validating rows remain non-authoritative until publication

observed_row_count, valid_identity_count and invalid_row_count are physical persisted observation-row counts, not logical deduplicated variant counts, and observed_row_count must equal valid_identity_count + invalid_row_count
warning_count excludes info, error and high_risk findings; those findings remain immutable/queryable but are not relabelled as warnings

at initial publication every generated or exact-reused validating-run proposal is pending, so accepted_proposal_count = rejected_proposal_count = deferred_proposal_count = 0 and proposal_count = pending_proposal_count

after publication every stored proposal-state counter must independently equal its matching persisted child-row count; proposal_count need not equal pending+accepted+rejected+deferred because superseded and no_change proposals have no dedicated import_runs summary columns

the exact command response remains bounded independently of proposal population size: it contains proposal_count, never proposal IDs; proposal IDs remain query authority only through deterministic pagination
OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED must not generate sr_source_disappearance_review proposals because historical/correction evidence cannot infer a new omission
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; internal command_id is generated by the durable-job handler for the exact publication operation and its semantic request hash binds job_id/import_run_id/expected run revision/profile versions/source candidate identity/logical fingerprint; committed replay returns the recorded publication result before any claim or mutable owner-state read, while a fresh execution requires the exact current claim plus exact current phase=publishing checkpoint witness and changed semantic input under the same command_id is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
receipt_order: exact committed replay lookup first -> for fresh execution call DurableJobCoordinator.assert_claim_current in the same UnitOfWork, consume/validate its returned current checkpoint witness and revalidate exact run/source state -> insert command_receipt -> guarded cleanup/publication writes -> for NEW_SOURCE advanced_search_sr only enqueue_or_coalesce ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile in the same UoW -> classification-specific audit/result -> commit
mutations: LLD-01 durable job enqueue for chronology-eligible advanced_search_sr reappearance reconciliation only
revision_effects: successful publication/noop state increments import_runs revision exactly once; failed/no-change does not
audit_action: fresh NEW_SOURCE, CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT and OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED publication emits exactly one ticket_import.run_published.v1 because source evidence becomes published authority; fresh EXACT_REPLAY_NOOP or NEWER_IDENTICAL_NO_DOMAIN_CHANGE emits exactly one ticket_import.run_noop_classified.v1 because only technical run state/cleanup changes; the noop-classified action is never source-publication authority, and exact committed command replay emits neither audit again
reappearance_rule: publication never clears an LLD-03 source-disappearance warning inline. NEW_SOURCE advanced_search_sr publication atomically enqueue_or_coalesces one run-keyed ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile job because its governed candidate chronology is strictly newer current population evidence. CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT publication does not enqueue reappearance work while recovery_required; if authorized equal-chronology correction later replaces the source checkpoint, FinalizeImportRunReview owns the atomic enqueue for that corrected run. OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED never enqueues automatic reappearance work because later publication time does not make older source chronology current presence authority. Any publication rollback leaves no runnable reappearance job.
post_commit_work: durable job continuation to review/noop checkpoint as dictated by committed state; only chronology-eligible advanced_search_sr source authority has the separately checkpointed ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile continuation
